verdict.rationale: The evidence shows E2B docs with static SDK code snippets (quickstart), an llms.txt index and markdown docs. Nothing documents an interactive API reference or a 'try it' playground where examples can be run in place. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Static snippets and machine-readable docs are adjacent features, not the interactive, runnable reference the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
